reasoning_content:
The full stack works end-to-end via caddy. Let me confirm the containers status and finalize.

Let me also double-check the docs' dev ports: caddy 4000, angular 4201, express-backend 5000, pg_admin 3838, kc-admin 4000/kc-admin, keycloak direct 28080, maildev 1080.

Let me verify pgadmin and maildev.

Also, let me consider restoring the realm.json passwordPolicy change? It's a modification to enable import. I'll note it. Actually let me verify whether the modification is truly needed or if there's another way — the dev passwords are single word lowercase, definitely fail specialChars. The guide explicitly says these are the passwords. This is a bug in the repo. To complete installation, relaxing the dev password policy is reasonable. I'll document it as an additional action.

Let me do final checks.

action.command: docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'; echo "=== ports ==="; for p in 4000 4201 5000 3838 28080 1080; do timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p" 2>/dev/null && echo "$p open" || echo "$p closed"; done; echo "--- pgadmin ---"; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w "pgadmin:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3838/; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w "maildev:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:1080/
